notes.title: HOTFIX - PATCH NOTES - V1.03.4
notes.content:
Hello again, non-floaty humans!

Gee-Louee, is it good to be back!


As a tiny dev team, we often find ourselves wishing we could just peacefully tend to our crops and collect the fanciest of farming apparels in the world of Voltaire, as it truly is (and will forever be!) a game very close to our hearts.



Since 2023 some of you have been kind enough to get in touch with us to let us know every time you found any pesky little critters that may not have been intended as the normal experience we'd love for y'all to have with the game, and we've done our best to keep up with any issues that could prevent you from enjoying your time with Voltaire - but a couple of them did slip through the cracks and we've been biting at our own necks in frustration for not quite being able to push out an update - but alas, the time has come!


Without further ado, patch notes ahead!


BUG FIXES & CHANGES



Fixed an issue that could cause the achievement "Fauna Connoisseur" to be harder to unlock than intended. If you have encountered this issue, \[spoiler] completing one full night in the Hellfire Plains or going into a night phase at 100 hunger and completing it \[/spoiler] should now grant you the achievement (as long as you were only missing the "hidden" critter).

Some of you encountered a very annoying issue that could make your nights seem infinite or not progress after defeating a Boss. This was caused by a very specific (and honestly, hard to control) set of events that could occur in a normal playthrough. Our goal had always been to make defeating the boss your main goal and concern during those challenging nights, but that challenge could often be multiplied by player decisions that may not have intended to create more hardship - and that we feel like we should have done a better job of informing with clear, easily accessible information at an earlier development stage. With that in mind, we have now updated the game's logic during Boss Nights to ensure that you can focus all of your efforts where they should be - protecting your house and defeating the big bad Grimlords! Defeating the bosses will now properly trigger the end of the night cycle and make all other baddies run away as they witness your prowess. This should also ensure that you may now progress any playthrough that happened to get stuck behind a boss fight not ending properly!


If you come across any other bugs or have valuable feedback, we'd love to hear from you! Join our Discord community and follow us on Twitter for the latest updates and direct communication with the devs. We're eager to enhance your gaming experience!

Thank you for joining us on this epic vegan adventure! 🦇🌿🎮

🦇 Ta-ta for now 🦇

notes.title: FANG-TASTIC SUMMER PATCH - PATCH NOTES V1.03
notes.content:
Hello, non-floaty humans!

If you were thinking about getting the game, now is a great time to do so. You can add the game to your collection for 40% off starting with the Steam Summer Sale on June 27th and ending an additional week after most sales end on July 19th!

Make sure to check out other great indie titles on sale to kick off your summer gaming!

Now let's get chomping on the fang-tastic additions and changes to get your summer started off right~


New Costume: Floaty Ducky!
 Get your Summer vibes going with a unique beachside look - tan lines and floater included! Like Nana used to say, better safe than soggy.
New Feature: Controller Haptics!
 Get a better feel for the game with the addition of a wee bit of rumbling, a generous pinch of tumbling, and a whole lot of trembling as you perform your daily duties with a controller in hand!
Bug Fixes
 Fixed an issue that could cause Mr Viktor to be extra-rude and refuse to give you a task or interact with the player, blocking progression in the Farming mode
 Fixed an issue that was causing the Veggiepedia to never complete the listing of baddies, preventing the player from unlocking the “Fauna Connoisseur” achievement
 Fixed an issue that could prevent the player from unlocking the “Who let the pets out?” achievement when using Poppycorns and Marsh’o’mellows to add up to the necessary count of 4 pets at once
 Mr Viktor finally realized that Winter season has been over for a couple of months, and adequately stored his celebratory costume away

Balance
 Once you defeat a Boss you will no longer need to continue to face an overly long amount of baddies, and will only have to make sure to defeat the ones that have already been spawned. This prevents interactions that could cause the Boss fight nights to overly extend due to the way the adaptive difficulty scaling was performing.

If you come across any bugs or have valuable feedback, we'd love to hear from you! Join our Discord community and follow us on Twitter for the latest updates and direct communication with the devs. We're eager to enhance your gaming experience!

Thank you for joining us on this epic vegan adventure! 🦇🌿🎮 

🦇 Ta-ta for now 🦇

notes.title: 1.0 release is coming soon... 🦇
notes.content:
Hello, fellow non-floaty humans! 🦇

The time has come for the big news we have all been waiting for, and we couldn't be more excited to share them with you. This will be a fun one!

Without further ado, Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire will be hitting 1.0 with a huuuge release patch in October of this year - just in time for Halloween! 🎃

—

We have been having a blast developing the world of a very floaty, very brave, and very compassionate vampire on a quest for survival, understanding and respect. Our whiteboards are still filled with countless scribbles of ideas that we'd love to expand this world with in the future, but we have been working long and hard to get you the full experience we promised you earlier this year - and we are just about ready to deliver!

If you haven't been keeping tabs on the project, or just tried it out somewhere along the way, below is a quick recap of what we’ve added to the game during Early Access. If you'd like more details on each item, check out this news article in our Discord:  Early Access Progression & Upcoming Price Change

 New veggies!
 New baddies!
 New defensive plants!
 New alchemical recipes!
 New material tiers!
 New systems!
 New game modes!
 New and improved UI!
 New cinematic ending!
 New achievements!

Aaand here are SOME of the awesome things coming to the game with its 1.0 release:

 Language Localizations!
 New vampiric classes!
 New bosses!
 New biomes!
 New constructibles!
 New consumables!
 New costumes!
 New spooky (and fun) mini-games!
 New progression systems!
 New max level!
 New and improved UI!
 Improved Steam Deck experience!
 Improved performance and optimization!
 Improved game modes!
 Improved balance, inputs and quality of life!
 Brand new cinematics!
 And more!

—

With this awesome news comes a very important step and a super urgent reminder!

During the past few months we have done our best to update the game with countless bug fixes, quality of life updates and fun new content - all very much guided by your feedback and fueled by your kind words. Now we're finally reaching the point where we feel that our work has enough value to be priced as a full product - and still remain respectful to all new players alike. That means it is also the time to update the game to its final pricing, as mentioned in our Early Access FAQ, which should be going into effect by the end of this week.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/450c3784903394ea95aa366ea48866559253aa4b.gif
And finally, it also means that if you haven't purchased the game yet, this remaining period will be your last chance to grab your Early Access badge of honor - meaning the Unicorn Onesie costume for Voltaire and Morgana, which will remain exclusive for players that support the game during the Early Access period, these last few weeks included!

To everyone who has already played the game, given us feedback or nudged us forward with kind words - thank you sooo much for your continued support!

Don’t forget - we have tons of content, all vegan and floaty, across our social media. Give us a shout on Twitter, or come chat with us in Discord. We’re always here to listen, give tips 😉, and talk about your feedback!

Now sharpen your fangs, rinse your veggies, and get ready to enjoy Voltaire 1.0!

🦇 Ta-ta for now 🦇

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - Content patch 9 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello, non-floaty human friends!

This week marks the first 2 months of Early Access for Voltaire, and we have a pretty exciting patch to celebrate the occasion! Along with 8 other content patches under our belt since release, we are pretty confident in the core we are creating and can't help but feel excited for the future of the game.

This major update sets an important milestone in our roadmap, but we have so much more already in the works behind the curtain that we can't wait to reveal, and more importantly, get your feedback on! This means we will soon be detailing more information about our list of upcoming features and shedding a light on our planned release windows for all the listings in our roadmap.

As per usual, with new content come new challenges, so if you have any feedback on these or any upcoming features please do share it with us. Now, without further ado... patch notes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/e45f91501ea26ee0bd3e51526ddeec417d3d8696.gif

NEW!

 New System: Class Modifiers
     Wield new powers and unique visual effects while progressing through skill trees that augment a specific playstyle!
 New Class: Pyromancer
     Transform into a flame-wielding sorcerer, focusing your power on ranged attacks and a scorching new firewall ability!
 New System: Events
     Meet new characters along the way and aid them through brand new quests!
 New Event: Elga’s Soups
     Soup-making is no joke, and Elga needs your help with… unusual ingredients!
 New Event: Ylga’s One-Stop-Broom-Shop
     Not quite a convenience store, but pretty conveniently stored!
 New Event: Olga’s Lost Pet
     Poor Mister Wiggles, where could it be?
 New baddie: Necromincer
     Often mistaken for a typo, Necromincers actually earned their name due to their unusual ritualistic practices, mostly involving minced skulls and fruit salads.
 New baddie: GubGub
     GubGubs are colorful critters that share a lot of similarities with most ancient species of beetles, with the exception of those found on a particular shade of yellow submarines.
 New baddie: Frostling
     With a coating of fur almost as thick as their wits, Frostlings are well prepared for snowy weather, harsh conditions, and spontaneous snowball fights alike.
 New baddie: Ghostavo
     Once a ragtag group of ruthless scallywags, Ghostavos now roam the lands as lost souls, often complimented for their transparency.
 New baddie: Raider
     A prevalent tribe across Transylvania’s Hunting Grounds, Raiders are an equal threat to innocent passersby, small critters, and unprotected fridges.
 New baddie: Treeant
     Even though they do move through complex underground tunnel systems, a Treeant really is mostly related to a tree, and not so much an ant.
 New baddie: Clayton
     These surly, bulky figures can be found across the steepest dunes and driest deserts, but such harsh conditions can make one kinda rude, especially during sandstorms.
 Updated baddie: Werebat
     Half bat, half wolf, half vampire and fully unaware of how math works.
 New QOL: Reactive Tutorials
     A more intuitive way to learn while embarking on your adventure (to be expanded!)
 New QOL: Skippable Tutorials
     Because some vampires have walked the walk and farmed the farm before.
 New QOL: Skippable Boss Animations
     Gone are the days of watching Skully laugh in our faces for the 7th time.


BUGFIXES

 Your custom zoom level will now be logged and should properly apply after you close any interface windows.
 Fixed an issue that could cause baddies to attack towards the opposite side of their target.
 Fixed an issue that could cause baddies to start attacking from further away than their intended range.
 Fixed an issue that could cause an incorrect image to display on under construction Haunted Mines and Haunted Sawmills


BALANCE

 Introduced new biome-specific baddies.
 Monastery Graveyard: Necromincers are frail baddies that will continuously summon floating skulls to attack for them.
 Green Grove: Treeants are mischievous baddies that will tunnel underground and pop out near your crops.
 Glowbug Forest: GubGubs are tiny critters that will spawn out of their eggs if not dealt with in time.
 Southerns Barrens: Claytons are bulky baddies that will split into two once defeated
 Hunting Grounds: Raiders are sturdy baddies composed of a werehog and its rider, and both must be defeated.
 Silverbane Bay: Ghostavos are sneaky swashbucklers that will remain immune to all sources of damage until they get close enough to their target.
 Snowscale Tundra: Frostlings are tricksters at heart that will mostly focus on hitting you with snowballs and stunning Voltaire.
 Castle Gardens: Werebats are Dracula’s minions and can fly over your traps or traverse terrain pretty quickly.
 Buffed Rootie-Frooties’ HP value by 1 point.
 Slightly reduced the total material cost of Haunted Mines and Haunted Sawmills.

BUGFIXES

BALANCE


 All defensive plants will now dry up if not watered after 1 day instead of 3
 Skully will now spawn minions slightly slower
 Yeetus’ base health points have been increased
 The total experience points necessary to reach level 20 have been slightly increased
 Soulstone Flowers will now gain a +1HP buff when planted next to each other instead of a double-dropping buff

WHAT’S NEXT?

We have been taking notes of all your feedback and will continue to do so for as long as it takes to make Voltaire the best game it can be.

This has been an amazing launch week and we feel great about the future of the game, especially thanks to all the awesomely supportive comments and heartwarming reviews you have been writing (thank you!), so we’re ecstatic to see that a small but wholesome community is already forming around our floaty vampire.

Our immediate plans are to tackle the most pressing bugfixes and adjustments you have been commenting on first, along with a steady stream of new content for you to enjoy every week during this upcoming month.

The great news is that, overall, you are reporting that the game is very stable and no major gamebreaking issues are happening very often, if at all. This means that we can safely focus on adding onto this base right away, tackling both new content and quality of life improvements all at once.

We have noticed a prevalent comment about the extent of our tutorial dialogues, as well as the fact that players often learn things by themselves way before uncles Frank and Stein ask them to perform those tasks for the first time.

With that in mind, we will be making adjustments to ensure our tutorials become more reactive to what the player has already done, as well as trimming down on superfluous texts where we feel like it is not adding to the humorous nature of the experience or containing essential information, which is also something we will try to keep in mind in future dialogues and textual information.

Besides this tutorial review, we’re also aware that you are craving for more variety (of every form!) so we will start by introducing new veggies, new defensive plants and new enemy critters that perform more complex roles, especially when it comes to making combat more dynamic.

Along with these smaller updates, we will also be focusing on introducing more constructible elements and random-chance encounters that will allow you to spend your materials and overflowing veggies in a meaningful way, which is something we will expand a lot further on in upcoming DevLogs.

Besides all of this, we will continue to cook-up larger patches that contain new activities, characters and game modes that break the mold of what you have already experienced, as well as constantly improving on balance and game feel along with your help and feedback.

We feel that this is a good recipe to begin our Early Access journey with, and we sincerely hope that you will tag along as we create, transform, and improve this adventure full of veggies, compassion, and spooky, heart-warming fun.

Ta-ta!

notes.title: DEVLOG #4 - Magic, Seeds, and Treasures, oh my! ?
notes.content:
Hello, non-floaty humans!

We’re so excited to share some updates with you!

We all know Voltaire has a farming aspect. After all, we need lots of yummy veggies to survive the vegan way! Sometimes farming can get boring, though, so we decided to (veganly) beef up the activities list.

There are many activities that complement the farming aspect and are intertwined incentives to organically lead you in your quest - for survival and for veganism! 

Potions, explosions, science, oh my! 

Alchemy is one example of our other(worldly) activities we have ready for you.
In your house, you have an alchemy table, and through this table, another world awaits you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/a7ca88e05c7e5f88af43e1b6716c7b7fa1547893.png

On another note - look at how cute our little house is on the inside! Anyway, here’s a close up look at the specific table we’re talking about:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/0e8ca8be77f556af67a6fe7d3133d514681e7ca8.png

Complete all of the recipes for bragging rights and our eternal undying affection! (And maybe an achievement…? Achievement hunters, keep your eyes peeled! 👀 )

Another example is digging.

Digging to clear out fields and harvesting may yield moldy treats.
These treats can then be offered to C’thul (our version of fishing!) in exchange for its gifts, such as soulstones, just like the screenshot below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/113af6ddb7fd0914f5f53480054cccf6f1889102.png

Why are soulstones important? 

Soulstones can then be used to unlock new boons, collect new cosmetics or even fulfill alchemical recipes that yield rare new seeds. These new seeds can then be sowed, watered and harvested thus completing a full circle of activities that started by simply digging a new field! Ah, the circle of life definitely moves us all. Well, sort of. We are undead, after all.

You keep talking about harvesting and gaining stuff. What if my inventory fills up and I don’t want this…stuff?

It’s okay if not everything sparks joy and you wish to remove it from your inventory! Composting is a way to both clean up your inventory and a way to level up faster, by turning unwanted seeds into useful XP to level up. Press F to pay respects (and to compost all seeds) 😉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/f934b8ec0d163b903394580f19ff916ac567a360.png

One more example of other(worldly) activities include treasure hunting!

You can hunt treasures across the map in order to earn unique rewards and XP. This allows for some fun and immersive exploration! We love shiny treasure 😭

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/b64020f680a32a7434ac80019280f88a54346177.png

Exploring the maps is another fun and exciting way to gain new items. You can also just simply enjoy the views! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/3e6e47ae9882ee8d343600f67146fff838d08d8f.png

Well, the sun’s going down, and you know what that means - it’s time for us to defend OUR crops from those pesky minions (known as bugs) by The Dracula himself. They won’t defeat themselves!

So thank you, as always, for your support during development! If you’d like to join our House, check us out on Discord, Twitter, or TikTok. We can’t wait to see you there!

🦇 Ta-ta! 🦇

notes.title: DEVLOG #3 - Trees and Biomes!
notes.content:
Greetings, non-floaty human friends!

In our quest for veganism, let’s talk about trees… specifically, Skill Trees!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/17d15ffbd877db0c7092dce4cd5d5b009bf3cf20.png

Our Skill Tree consists of 3 unique choices every time you level up. 

Those choices heavily modify your build and gameplay, affecting everything from attacks, abilities, and cooldowns to movement, pets, and more!

These choices are always impactful and must be chosen carefully…
…Or not! Since you will maintain your experience progression even if you die and will be refunded all of your skill points, you can happily experiment as often as you wish.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/0ba015fb442347ce2b39ceb9735bdec5ff6c014f.png

Something else we should talk about is our environment. As you all know, the environment is super important to things we grow. That’s why we have different Biomes to explore!

These biomes also represent new challenges to overcome, new veggies to discover, new weathers to endure and new bosses to defeat. They embody a new mood and environment as each biome is a unique map with different boundaries and different fields to sow. This also means each biome requires different strategies to thrive in.

Biomes represent the our physical progression across the lands of Transylvania, but also serve as checkpoints. If (or when) you lose, you will never revert past the day you arrived at your latest biome.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/05293dc20b371cb54af25f8ba64ae9bb4c6f944d.png
(Side note: look at how cute our little mushroom cabin is!)

Thank you, as always, for your support during development! If you’d like to join our House, check us out on Discord, Twitter, and TikTok. We can’t wait to see you there!

🦇 Ta-ta! 🦇

notes.title: DEVLOG #2 - Duality [Part 2/2]
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow non-floaty humans!

There’s so much happening behind the curtains that we can’t wait to share with you!

We’re currently hard at work on a playable demo that we’re planning to release soon, so you may very well be getting your own introduction into the world and gameplay of Voltaire in a very near future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/2404dac45c1de5a0bfa280053219f09ffd6fd84b.png

This also means that, starting next week, we’ll have plenty of new goodies to showcase while getting the word out on our social media, so if you haven’t yet, please consider checking out our twitter for even more information and hot-out-of-the-press news!

Here’s a link to our Twitter!

Continuing on the topic: Duality ☯️

In our last entry, we briefly talked about our day and night cycles and how they shape player experiences at their very core. This time we’ll focus on our ideas regarding player choice, difficulty scaling and risk versus reward!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/7ba5b57f14202c601828e2d22d5ca37a7a83bc5e.png

In Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire, it is you, the player, who decides just how much you’re willing to risk for both short-term and long-term rewards, and just how much you believe in your ability to get there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/5710d5f2d9988382c819dad1af8d97ed99e347d9.png

Some players prefer to rely on their creativity, careful planning and strategy, while others may rely on their reactive abilities and combat skills, so it was important for us to build a system that could be flexible enough to guarantee that, regardless of the kind of player you are, you would be able to get the kind of challenge you want - and of course, the more difficult you make it, the better the rewards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/7569ddb24a042876c8dc345140a148028188f96a.png

While it sounds like a complex problem, the solution was quite simple! In Voltaire, every time you choose to embrace the darkness of the night, you must face Dracula’s goons and prevent them from destroying your crops and your reliquary (that’s fancy-talk for your house).

The type, amount and aggressiveness of these goons will be a direct result of the kind and amount of crops you’re growing, with each type being especially luring to each enemy archetype.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/28ea95c71698d97122c9568abb69d5aeb3bd57b7.png

In direct relation, the rewards that each of those crops will eventually yield are also very much tied to the effort it takes to both grow them and keep them safe, so you will always be the master of your own fate while balancing risk and reward.

The Skill Tree

Another way to ensure that your strategy and skill actually matters in Voltaire is through the way we’re approaching the Skill Tree. After all, you are the son of Dracula, a master of the dark arts, a fierce, floaty predator and the spawn of the devil itself… well, kind of. But we couldn’t just give you a 5% extra chance to look at a slightly higher number on the screen, we want to shapeshift your combat experience every time your XP bar dings.

But hey, that’s an amazing topic to delve further into in our next devlog entry, so make sure you stay tuned if you’d like to hear more about it!

Oh! And, as always, don't forget to sharpen your fangs, eat your veggies, and consider Wishlisting the game if you like what you've seen so far!

🦇 Ta-ta! 🦇

notes.title: DEVLOG #1 - Duality [Part 1/2]
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow non-floaty humans!

This short article will serve as a debut into a series of insights about the development of Voltaire, including what we consider our core concepts, design philosophies and ideas we have for the future of the game.

Occasionally we may also reveal a couple of more personal insights about us, the team of whimsical developers behind the curtains, so you may even get a glimpse into who's creating your game!

Well then, onwards with it!

Today's topic: Duality ☯️

From very early on, we decided that we wanted the core ideas in Voltaire to revolve around a very simple concept of duality, meaning we were looking to introduce some form of contrast in the way the game feels throughout it's most basic gameplay loop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/f2d2fa366ef80e1637d8802488af7c5bc9f432d8.jpg

One of the more obvious ways we embraced this concept was by creating two very distinct day and night cycles, with day-time being a stress-free, soothing, farming simulation and resource management cycle...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/27c0beaca3862904664f16617992ab0180169210.jpg

...whereas night-time brings action, combat and even requires a healthy amount of careful planning from our players!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195734/84cd275f6c6b5ef0b0c11b2fa60b6ea5c7eadcee.jpg

This makes Voltaire an interesting combination of two often opposing game concepts and genres: it's both an action-riddled roguelite, and a whimsical farming-sim with tons of opportunities for player creativity.

Stay tuned for [Part 2/2] where we will continue to expand on how this concept is helping us shape the world of Voltaire.

Oh! And don't forget to sharpen your fangs, eat your veggies, and consider Wishlisting the game if you like what you've seen so far!

🦇 Ta-ta! 🦇
